product_one_liner.value: Aikido provides developer-first software-security tools that detect and fix risks across code, cloud, and runtime so development teams can ship securely without slowing down.
product_one_liner.notes: Aikido’s press kit describes developer-first security products and says the platform secures code, cloud, and runtime for teams, supporting the concise product-and-audience summary.
